findings.title: UI open failure is logged as a warning, not an error
findings.description: In `_select_report`, the branch that detects a failed annual-report window open was changed from `push_error` to `push_warning`. The failure is still swallowed into a retry path (`_reopen_pending = true`), so the only trace of a broken UI is a warning that is easy to miss in the console. Any later presentation failure of this kind will be reported at the same lower severity, which hides a real fault from operators.

citations.citation: Keynes: errors fail loudly instead of falling back silently

if _ui.has_method("is_annual_report_open") and not bool(_ui.is_annual_report_open()):
		push_warning("[annual] report workspace failed to open for id=%d" % id)
		_open = false
		# The executor still owns this confirmation point. Keep the published report
		# and let the normal presentation hooks retry instead of losing the queue.
		_reopen_pending = true

evidence.explanation: The compliance rule requires that a failed UI call be reported with `push_error` while the operation stops and keeps the previous state. The PR keeps the state-preserving retry but replaces `push_error` with `push_warning`, so the failure is no longer reported at error level.

findings.title: Players stay blocked after a failed report open
findings.description: `_select_report()` sets `_reopen_pending` when the workspace fails to open, but the flag does not schedule another `try_present()` call. If the UI remains unavailable through the confirmation-update and simulation-commit hooks, the executor can remain blocked at confirmation; an unchanged confirmation emits no new update, and no subsequent day can commit to trigger a retry when the UI returns.

func _on_simulation_committed(_from_day: int, _to_day: int, _generation: int) -> void:
	if _runtime_host == null or _world_clock == null:
		return
	if _music_situation != null:
		_music_situation.refresh_global_from_commit()
	_sync_era_reward_offer()
	_sync_family_founding_offer()
	_sync_ideology_draw()
	_sync_era_music()
	_sync_event_audio()
	_refresh_era_advancement()
	_narrative_service.consume_committed()
	_annual_report_flow.try_present()
	_narrative_flow.try_present()

var failed_open_host := HostStub.new()
	var failed_open_ui := UiStub.new()
	failed_open_ui.fail_next_open = true
	var failed_open_flow := Flow.new()
	failed_open_flow.configure(ControllerStub.new(), failed_open_host, failed_open_ui)
	failed_open_flow.queue_report(1)
	var failed_open_state: Dictionary = failed_open_flow.capture()
	_expect("failed report opening preserves the executor confirmation for retry",
		not failed_open_flow.is_open() and failed_open_state.get("open", false)
		and failed_open_state.get("report_id", 0) == 1
		and failed_open_host.marked_ids.is_empty())
	failed_open_flow.try_present()
	_expect("a later presentation hook reopens the failed report",
		failed_open_flow.is_open() and failed_open_ui.opened == 2)
	failed_open_ui.annual_report_closed.emit(1)
	_expect("closing the reopened report acknowledges the executor stop",
		failed_open_host.marked_ids == [1])

evidence.explanation: The pending flag is consumed only by `try_present()`. Production calls it on confirmation updates and simulation commits, but the report-ready session announces each report ID once, an unchanged confirmation view emits no further update, and the executor may block before another commit. The added test calls `try_present()` directly, so it does not establish that a retry occurs after those hooks have passed.
